title: ProxVC++
description: Simple voice chat mod with some QOL features made for  BTA.
body:
# ProxVC![++](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55ce95b16a7f775d3536eb5678230414a4c28caa.png) 
> Expansion/fork of [5Avian's ProxVC mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/proxvc) with expanded QOL features.

**Proxmity chat on any BTA Babric server.**

Simply install the mod on both the **server** and the **client**, configure your mic input, _and voilà!_

All of the settings for the mod can be found in the ProxVC page of the options screen. There you can turn on **push-to-talk**, **change your mic input**, **edit your keybinds**, **etc**.

The mic indicator found at the bottom left should reflect the current state of your audio input including if you are muted, talking, idle, or missing an input device.

![Mic indictator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/33ce92e56970c6b4141bae2eec46fc5f08b2e7be.png)

 **Expanded Features**
* Per-Player Volume Mixer
* Sound Occlusion
* Movable/Toggable HUD
* Voice waveforms for clarity.

## Technical stuff

**On the server**, this mod will open a UDP server on the same **address & port** as the Minecraft TCP server.

**On the client**, this mod will send voice chat packets to the UDP server of the current server when connected to a server.

If your server is encountering issues with ProxVC, please ensure that your firewall isn't **blocking traffic** to the UDP port.
> _Taken from 5Avian's original description_

---
_This mod uses a modified version of Fabric (Babric) and is designed only for Better than Adventure, a heavily modified version of Minecraft b1.7.3!_
